"""smoke-llm: mede o LLM real com ~15 mensagens ESCRITAS A MAO e SEM PII, antes de construir o agente em cima dele.

    make smoke-llm                 # precisa de ANTHROPIC_API_KEY no ambiente ou em .env (ignorado pelo git)
    make smoke-llm-dry             # encanamento completo com um LLM de mentira, sem chave e sem rede

O que mede (docs/PLAN.md, secao 5.4): latencia por chamada e o p95 do TURNO projetado a partir dela, tokens/s, `usage`, saida estruturada
valida, precisao de extracao separando erro SILENCIOSO de omissao, aprovacao do guardrail, tamanho do reply (alvo de 40 palavras),
divergencia regex vs LLM (decide o fast-path) e custo.

Garantias: (1) cada mensagem e `hand-written`; (2) o detector de PII roda em TODO payload antes do envio e a execucao ABORTA se achar algo;
(3) este script nao tem acesso ao dataset; (4) a chave nunca e impressa nem gravada. O relatorio vai para var/smoke/ (ignorado pelo git).

15 mensagens NAO certificam taxas: o smoke e um alarme contra problemas grosseiros, nao um benchmark.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
import re
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
from analysis import cost_model  # noqa: E402
from analysis.e2e_latency_sim import derive_llm_call_limit, project_turn_p95  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro import budgets  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.facts import FactBase, strip_accents  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.fastpath import fast_extract  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.guardrail import check_reply  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.claude import ClaudeLLM, LLMResult, Usage  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.prompt import build_system_prompt, build_user_message  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.schema import SlotValue, TurnOutput  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.pii import find_pii  # noqa: E402
from tools.smoke_messages import MESSAGES, SMOKE_TODAY, SmokeMessage  # noqa: E402

MODEL_PRICE_KEY = {"claude-haiku-5-5": "haiku-5-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5": "sonnet-5-5", "claude-opus-5-5": "opus-5-5"}


class UnsafePayload(RuntimeError):
    """Algo que parece PII ou segredo estava prestes a sair da maquina. Nada foi enviado."""


def assert_safe_to_send(*texts: str) -> None:
    kinds = sorted({k for t in texts for k in find_pii(t)})
    if kinds:
        raise UnsafePayload(f"PII/segredo detectado ({', '.join(kinds)}); nada foi enviado")


def load_env(path: Path) -> None:
    """Le KEY=VALUE de um .env sem sobrescrever o que ja esta no ambiente. Nunca imprime valores."""
    if not path.exists():
        return
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        value = value.strip().strip("'\"")
        if value:
            os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value)


def load_fact_base() -> FactBase:
    return FactBase.from_planos(json.loads((ROOT / "vendor" / "quote-service" / "data" / "plans.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))


def norm(slot: str, value: str) -> str:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", value)
    if slot in ("idade", "veiculo_ano"):
        return str(int(digits)) if digits else value.strip().lower()
    if slot == "cep":
        return digits
    return value.strip().lower()


# --- LLM de mentira (--dry-run e testes) --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class DryRunLLM:
    """Responde com o gabarito, so para provar o encanamento. Os numeros que ele gera NAO valem nada."""

    def __init__(self, model: str, fact_base: FactBase, seed: int = 1) -> None:
        self.model, self.system_prompt = model, build_system_prompt(fact_base)
        self._rng = random.Random(seed)
        self._by_text = {m.text: m for m in MESSAGES}

    def turn(self, user_message: str) -> LLMResult:
        msg = next((m for t, m in self._by_text.items() if user_message.endswith(t)), None)
        assert msg is not None, "mensagem desconhecida no dry-run"
        slots = [SlotValue(s, v, False) for s, v in msg.expected.items()] + [SlotValue(s, "?", True) for s in msg.expect_ambiguous]
        carencia = "carencia" in msg.must_cite
        reply = ("Roubo e furto só passam a valer 30 dias depois do início da vigência." if carencia else "Anotado! Pode me contar mais um pouco?")
        out = TurnOutput(tuple(slots), sorted(msg.intents)[0], ("carencia",) if carencia else (), reply)
        latency = self._rng.lognormvariate(math.log(0.9), 0.4)
        return LLMResult(out, None, latency, Usage(2400, 130), "end_turn")


# --- execucao e pontuacao ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class CallRecord:
    msg_id: str
    model: str
    repeat: int
    warmup: bool
    error: str | None
    latency_s: float
    usage: dict | None
    output: dict | None
    score: dict


def score_call(msg: SmokeMessage, res: LLMResult, base: FactBase) -> dict:
    s: dict = {"valid": res.output is not None}
    if res.output is None:
        return s
    out, wrong_silent, kinds = res.output, 0, {}
    ambiguous = out.ambiguous()
    for slot, want in msg.expected.items():
        got = out.entries(slot)
        if not got:
            kinds[slot] = "omitted"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "correct"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want):
            kinds[slot] = "correct_flagged"
        elif slot in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "wrong_flagged"
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_WRONG"
            wrong_silent += 1
    for slot in msg.expect_ambiguous:
        if out.entries(slot) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_VALUE_ON_AMBIGUOUS"
            wrong_silent += 1
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "ok_flagged_or_absent"
    for slot in {e.slot for e in out.slots} - set(msg.expected) - set(msg.expect_ambiguous):
        if slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_EXTRA"
            wrong_silent += 1
    lead_texts = [t for role, t in msg.history if role == "lead"] + [msg.text] + [f"{k} {v}" for k, v in msg.known_slots.items()]
    violations = check_reply(out.reply, facts_used=out.facts_used, base=base, lead_texts=lead_texts)
    plain = strip_accents(out.reply).lower()
    fast = fast_extract(msg.asked_slot, msg.text, today=SMOKE_TODAY)
    llm_value = out.value(msg.asked_slot) if msg.asked_slot else None
    s.update(slot_outcomes=kinds, silent_wrong=wrong_silent, intent_ok=out.intent in msg.intents,
             guardrail_ok=not violations, violations=sorted({v.rule for v in violations}),
             forbidden_leak=[f for f in msg.forbidden_in_reply if strip_accents(f).lower() in plain],
             cited_required=set(msg.must_cite) <= set(out.facts_used), reply_words=len(out.reply.split()),
             fast_value=fast, fast_diverges=bool(fast is not None and (llm_value is None or norm(msg.asked_slot, llm_value) != norm(msg.asked_slot, fast))))
    return s


def run_model(llm, base: FactBase, messages, repeats: int) -> list[CallRecord]:
    """Uma chamada de aquecimento (a 1a com um esquema novo paga compilacao) fica FORA das estatisticas."""
    records: list[CallRecord] = []
    plan = [(messages[0], 0, True)] + [(m, r, False) for r in range(1, repeats + 1) for m in messages]
    for msg, rep, warm in plan:
        user = build_user_message(today=SMOKE_TODAY, known_slots=msg.known_slots, asked_slot=msg.asked_slot, history=msg.history, message=msg.text)
        assert msg.source == "hand-written", f"{msg.id}: so mensagens escritas a mao podem sair da maquina"
        assert_safe_to_send(llm.system_prompt, user)
        res = llm.turn(user)
        records.append(CallRecord(msg.id, llm.model, rep, warm, res.error, res.latency_s,
                                  None if res.usage is None else res.usage.__dict__,
                                  None if res.output is None else {"slots": [s.__dict__ for s in res.output.slots], "intent": res.output.intent,
                                                                   "facts_used": list(res.output.facts_used), "reply": res.output.reply},
                                  score_call(msg, res, base)))
    return records


def pct(xs: list[float], p: float) -> float:
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p / 100 * len(xs)))] if xs else float("nan")


def summarize(records: list[CallRecord], model: str) -> dict:
    rs = [r for r in records if not r.warmup]
    ok = [r for r in rs if r.score.get("valid")]
    lat = [r.latency_s for r in rs if r.error is None]
    words = [r.score["reply_words"] for r in ok]
    usage = [r.usage for r in rs if r.usage]
    price = cost_model.PRICES.get(MODEL_PRICE_KEY.get(model, ""), None)
    per_call_usd = None
    if price and usage:
        per_call_usd = sum((u["input_tokens"] * price["inp"] + u["cache_read_tokens"] * price["inp"] * price["read"]
                            + u["cache_write_tokens"] * price["inp"] * cost_model.WRITE_5M + u["output_tokens"] * price["out"]) / 1e6
                           for u in usage) / len(usage)
    fast_applies = [r for r in ok if r.score["fast_value"] is not None]
    projection = project_turn_p95(lat) if lat else None
    s = {
        "model": model, "calls": len(rs), "errors": sorted({r.error for r in rs if r.error}),
        "warmup_latency_s": next((round(r.latency_s, 2) for r in records if r.warmup), None),
        "latency_s": {"p50": round(pct(lat, 50), 2), "p95": round(pct(lat, 95), 2), "p99": round(pct(lat, 99), 2), "max": round(max(lat), 2)} if lat else None,
        "projected_turn_p95_s": projection,
        "mean_input_tokens": round(sum(u["input_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_output_tokens": round(sum(u["output_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_cache_read_tokens": round(sum(u["cache_read_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "output_tokens_per_s": round(sum(r.usage["output_tokens"] / r.latency_s for r in rs if r.usage and r.latency_s) / max(1, len(usage)), 1) if usage else None,
        "usd_per_call": None if per_call_usd is None else round(per_call_usd, 6),
        "valid_output_rate": round(len(ok) / len(rs), 3) if rs else 0.0,
        "silent_wrong": sum(r.score["silent_wrong"] for r in ok),
        "omissions": sum(v == "omitted" for r in ok for v in r.score["slot_outcomes"].values()),
        "intent_accuracy": round(sum(r.score["intent_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_pass_rate": round(sum(r.score["guardrail_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_violations": {rule: sum(rule in r.score["violations"] for r in ok) for rule in sorted({v for r in ok for v in r.score["violations"]})},
        "forbidden_leaks": sum(len(r.score["forbidden_leak"]) for r in ok),
        "required_fact_cited": all(r.score["cited_required"] for r in ok),
        "reply_words": {"mean": round(sum(words) / len(words), 1), "p95": pct(words, 95), "max": max(words),
                        "share_le_target": round(sum(w <= budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS for w in words) / len(words), 3)} if words else None,
        "fast_path": {"applicable_calls": len(fast_applies), "abstained_calls": len(ok) - len(fast_applies),
                      "divergences": sum(r.score["fast_diverges"] for r in ok)},
    }
    lim = derive_llm_call_limit(n=15_000)
    s["derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s"] = lim["binding_llm_call_p95_max_s"]
    s["checks"] = {
        "0 extracoes erradas em silencio": s["silent_wrong"] == 0,
        "saida estruturada valida em 100%": s["valid_output_rate"] == 1.0,
        f"p95 projetado do turno sem cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["no_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S),
        f"p95 projetado do turno com cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["with_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S),
        "guardrail aprova >= 80% dos replies": s["guardrail_pass_rate"] >= 0.8,
        f"reply curto: >= 90% com <= {budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS} palavras e nenhum acima de {budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS}":
            bool(words) and s["reply_words"]["share_le_target"] >= 0.9 and max(words) <= budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS,
        "nenhum reply com termo proibido": s["forbidden_leaks"] == 0,
    }
    s["passes"] = all(s["checks"].values())
    s["fast_path_verdict"] = "REMOVER (divergiu do LLM)" if s["fast_path"]["divergences"] else "sem divergencia nesta amostra (ainda precisa de ganho medido para ligar)"
    return s


def print_report(summaries: list[dict], dry: bool) -> None:
    if dry:
        print("\n*** DRY-RUN: LLM de mentira. Estes numeros provam o ENCANAMENTO e nao valem nada como medicao. ***")
    for s in summaries:
        print(f"\n=== {s['model']} | {s['calls']} chamadas (aquecimento {s['warmup_latency_s']}s, fora das estatisticas)")
        if s["latency_s"]:
            l, p = s["latency_s"], s["projected_turn_p95_s"]
            print(f"  latencia por chamada  p50 {l['p50']}s  p95 {l['p95']}s  p99 {l['p99']}s  max {l['max']}s   (limite derivado do criterio: p95 <= {s['derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s']}s)")
            print(f"  p95 do TURNO projetado  sem cotacao {p['no_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)   com cotacao {p['with_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)")
        print(f"  tokens medios  entrada {s['mean_input_tokens']}  saida {s['mean_output_tokens']}  saida/s {s['output_tokens_per_s']}   US$/chamada {s['usd_per_call']}")
        print(f"  extracao  erros silenciosos {s['silent_wrong']}   omissoes {s['omissions']}   intent {s['intent_accuracy']}   saida valida {s['valid_output_rate']}")
        print(f"  guardrail aprova {s['guardrail_pass_rate']}  violacoes {s['guardrail_violations']}   reply {s['reply_words']}")
        print(f"  fast-path {s['fast_path']}  ->  {s['fast_path_verdict']}")
        for name, ok in s["checks"].items():
            print(f"    [{'ok' if ok else 'FALHA'}] {name}")
        print(f"  VEREDITO: {'PASSA' if s['passes'] else 'NAO PASSA'}   (15 mensagens: alarme, nao benchmark)")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--models", default="claude-haiku-5-5,claude-sonnet-5-5")
    ap.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--prompt-cache", action="store_true", help="liga cache_control no prefixo estatico (desligado por padrao)")
    ap.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "var" / "smoke")
    ap.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="so para testes: aponta o SDK para um servidor local")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    base = load_fact_base()
    load_env(ROOT / ".env")
    if not a.dry_run and not os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"):
        print("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ausente. Copie .env.example para .env e preencha, ou rode `make smoke-llm-dry`.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    models = [m.strip() for m in a.models.split(",") if m.strip()]
    all_records: dict[str, list[CallRecord]] = {}
    summaries = []
    try:
        for model in models:
            llm = DryRunLLM(model, base) if a.dry_run else ClaudeLLM(model, base, prompt_cache=a.prompt_cache, base_url=a.base_url)
            all_records[model] = run_model(llm, base, MESSAGES, a.repeats)
            summaries.append(summarize(all_records[model], model))
    except UnsafePayload as exc:
        print(f"ABORTADO: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    print_report(summaries, a.dry_run)
    a.out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + ("-dry" if a.dry_run else "")
    path = a.out_dir / f"smoke-{stamp}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps({"dry_run": a.dry_run, "today": SMOKE_TODAY.isoformat(), "summaries": summaries,
                                "calls": [r.__dict__ for rs in all_records.values() for r in rs]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nrelatorio completo (com cada reply, para ler a olho): {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    return 0 if all(s["passes"] for s in summaries) or a.dry_run else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    ambiguous = out.ambiguous()
    for slot, want in msg.expected.items():
        got = out.entries(slot)
        if not got:
            kinds[slot] = "omitted"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "correct"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want):
            kinds[slot] = "correct_flagged"
        elif slot in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "wrong_flagged"
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_WRONG"
            wrong_silent += 1
    for slot in msg.expect_ambiguous:
        if out.entries(slot) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_VALUE_ON_AMBIGUOUS"
            wrong_silent += 1
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "ok_flagged_or_absent"
    for slot in {e.slot for e in out.slots} - set(msg.expected) - set(msg.expect_ambiguous):
        if slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_EXTRA"
            wrong_silent += 1
    lead_texts = [t for role, t in msg.history if role == "lead"] + [msg.text] + [f"{k} {v}" for k, v in msg.known_slots.items()]
    violations = check_reply(out.reply, facts_used=out.facts_used, base=base, lead_texts=lead_texts)
    plain = strip_accents(out.reply).lower()
    fast = fast_extract(msg.asked_slot, msg.text, today=SMOKE_TODAY)
    llm_value = out.value(msg.asked_slot) if msg.asked_slot else None
    s.update(slot_outcomes=kinds, silent_wrong=wrong_silent, intent_ok=out.intent in msg.intents,
             guardrail_ok=not violations, violations=sorted({v.rule for v in violations}),
             forbidden_leak=[f for f in msg.forbidden_in_reply if strip_accents(f).lower() in plain],
             cited_required=set(msg.must_cite) <= set(out.facts_used), reply_words=len(out.reply.split()),
             fast_value=fast, fast_diverges=bool(fast is not None and (llm_value is None or norm(msg.asked_slot, llm_value) != norm(msg.asked_slot, fast))))
    return s


def run_model(llm, base: FactBase, messages, repeats: int) -> list[CallRecord]:
    """Uma chamada de aquecimento (a 1a com um esquema novo paga compilacao) fica FORA das estatisticas."""
    records: list[CallRecord] = []
    plan = [(messages[0], 0, True)] + [(m, r, False) for r in range(1, repeats + 1) for m in messages]
    for msg, rep, warm in plan:
        user = build_user_message(today=SMOKE_TODAY, known_slots=msg.known_slots, asked_slot=msg.asked_slot, history=msg.history, message=msg.text)
        assert msg.source == "hand-written", f"{msg.id}: so mensagens escritas a mao podem sair da maquina"
        assert_safe_to_send(llm.system_prompt, user)
        res = llm.turn(user)
        records.append(CallRecord(msg.id, llm.model, rep, warm, res.error, res.latency_s,
                                  None if res.usage is None else res.usage.__dict__,
                                  None if res.output is None else {"slots": [s.__dict__ for s in res.output.slots], "intent": res.output.intent,
                                                                   "facts_used": list(res.output.facts_used), "reply": res.output.reply},
                                  score_call(msg, res, base)))
    return records


def pct(xs: list[float], p: float) -> float:
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p / 100 * len(xs)))] if xs else float("nan")


def summarize(records: list[CallRecord], model: str) -> dict:
    rs = [r for r in records if not r.warmup]
    ok = [r for r in rs if r.score.get("valid")]
    lat = [r.latency_s for r in rs if r.error is None]
    words = [r.score["reply_words"] for r in ok]
    usage = [r.usage for r in rs if r.usage]
    price = cost_model.PRICES.get(MODEL_PRICE_KEY.get(model, ""), None)
    per_call_usd = None
    if price and usage:
        per_call_usd = sum((u["input_tokens"] * price["inp"] + u["cache_read_tokens"] * price["inp"] * price["read"]
                            + u["cache_write_tokens"] * price["inp"] * cost_model.WRITE_5M + u["output_tokens"] * price["out"]) / 1e6
                           for u in usage) / len(usage)
    fast_applies = [r for r in ok if r.score["fast_value"] is not None]
    projection = project_turn_p95(lat) if lat else None
    s = {
        "model": model, "calls": len(rs), "errors": sorted({r.error for r in rs if r.error}),
        "warmup_latency_s": next((round(r.latency_s, 2) for r in records if r.warmup), None),
        "latency_s": {"p50": round(pct(lat, 50), 2), "p95": round(pct(lat, 95), 2), "p99": round(pct(lat, 99), 2), "max": round(max(lat), 2)} if lat else None,
        "projected_turn_p95_s": projection,
        "mean_input_tokens": round(sum(u["input_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_output_tokens": round(sum(u["output_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_cache_read_tokens": round(sum(u["cache_read_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "output_tokens_per_s": round(sum(r.usage["output_tokens"] / r.latency_s for r in rs if r.usage and r.latency_s) / max(1, len(usage)), 1) if usage else None,
        "usd_per_call": None if per_call_usd is None else round(per_call_usd, 6),
        "valid_output_rate": round(len(ok) / len(rs), 3) if rs else 0.0,
        "silent_wrong": sum(r.score["silent_wrong"] for r in ok),
        "omissions": sum(v == "omitted" for r in ok for v in r.score["slot_outcomes"].values()),
        "intent_accuracy": round(sum(r.score["intent_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_pass_rate": round(sum(r.score["guardrail_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_violations": {rule: sum(rule in r.score["violations"] for r in ok) for rule in sorted({v for r in ok for v in r.score["violations"]})},
        "forbidden_leaks": sum(len(r.score["forbidden_leak"]) for r in ok),
        "required_fact_cited": all(r.score["cited_required"] for r in ok),
        "reply_words": {"mean": round(sum(words) / len(words), 1), "p95": pct(words, 95), "max": max(words),
                        "share_le_target": round(sum(w <= budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS for w in words) / len(words), 3)} if words else None,
        "fast_path": {"applicable_calls": len(fast_applies), "abstained_calls": len(ok) - len(fast_applies),
                      "divergences": sum(r.score["fast_diverges"] for r in ok)},
    }
    lim = derive_llm_call_limit(n=15_000)
    s["derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s"] = lim["binding_llm_call_p95_max_s"]
    s["checks"] = {
        "0 extracoes erradas em silencio": s["silent_wrong"] == 0,
        "saida estruturada valida em 100%": s["valid_output_rate"] == 1.0,
        f"p95 projetado do turno sem cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["no_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S),
        f"p95 projetado do turno com cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["with_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S),
        "guardrail aprova >= 80% dos replies": s["guardrail_pass_rate"] >= 0.8,
        f"reply curto: >= 90% com <= {budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS} palavras e nenhum acima de {budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS}":
            bool(words) and s["reply_words"]["share_le_target"] >= 0.9 and max(words) <= budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS,
        "nenhum reply com termo proibido": s["forbidden_leaks"] == 0,
    }
    s["passes"] = all(s["checks"].values())
    s["fast_path_verdict"] = "REMOVER (divergiu do LLM)" if s["fast_path"]["divergences"] else "sem divergencia nesta amostra (ainda precisa de ganho medido para ligar)"
    return s


def print_report(summaries: list[dict], dry: bool) -> None:
    if dry:
        print("\n*** DRY-RUN: LLM de mentira. Estes numeros provam o ENCANAMENTO e nao valem nada como medicao. ***")
    for s in summaries:
        print(f"\n=== {s['model']} | {s['calls']} chamadas (aquecimento {s['warmup_latency_s']}s, fora das estatisticas)")
        if s["latency_s"]:
            l, p = s["latency_s"], s["projected_turn_p95_s"]
            print(f"  latencia por chamada  p50 {l['p50']}s  p95 {l['p95']}s  p99 {l['p99']}s  max {l['max']}s   (limite derivado do criterio: p95 <= {s['derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s']}s)")
            print(f"  p95 do TURNO projetado  sem cotacao {p['no_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)   com cotacao {p['with_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)")
        print(f"  tokens medios  entrada {s['mean_input_tokens']}  saida {s['mean_output_tokens']}  saida/s {s['output_tokens_per_s']}   US$/chamada {s['usd_per_call']}")
        print(f"  extracao  erros silenciosos {s['silent_wrong']}   omissoes {s['omissions']}   intent {s['intent_accuracy']}   saida valida {s['valid_output_rate']}")
        print(f"  guardrail aprova {s['guardrail_pass_rate']}  violacoes {s['guardrail_violations']}   reply {s['reply_words']}")
        print(f"  fast-path {s['fast_path']}  ->  {s['fast_path_verdict']}")
        for name, ok in s["checks"].items():
            print(f"    [{'ok' if ok else 'FALHA'}] {name}")
        print(f"  VEREDITO: {'PASSA' if s['passes'] else 'NAO PASSA'}   (15 mensagens: alarme, nao benchmark)")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--models", default="claude-haiku-5-5,claude-sonnet-5-5")
    ap.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--prompt-cache", action="store_true", help="liga cache_control no prefixo estatico (desligado por padrao)")
    ap.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "var" / "smoke")
    ap.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="so para testes: aponta o SDK para um servidor local")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    base = load_fact_base()
    load_env(ROOT / ".env")
    if not a.dry_run and not os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"):
        print("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ausente. Copie .env.example para .env e preencha, ou rode `make smoke-llm-dry`.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    models = [m.strip() for m in a.models.split(",") if m.strip()]
    all_records: dict[str, list[CallRecord]] = {}
    summaries = []
    try:
        for model in models:
            llm = DryRunLLM(model, base) if a.dry_run else ClaudeLLM(model, base, prompt_cache=a.prompt_cache, base_url=a.base_url)
            all_records[model] = run_model(llm, base, MESSAGES, a.repeats)
            summaries.append(summarize(all_records[model], model))
    except UnsafePayload as exc:
        print(f"ABORTADO: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    print_report(summaries, a.dry_run)
    a.out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + ("-dry" if a.dry_run else "")
    path = a.out_dir / f"smoke-{stamp}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps({"dry_run": a.dry_run, "today": SMOKE_TODAY.isoformat(), "summaries": summaries,
                                "calls": [r.__dict__ for rs in all_records.values() for r in rs]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nrelatorio completo (com cada reply, para ler a olho): {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    return 0 if all(s["passes"] for s in summaries) or a.dry_run else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""smoke-llm: mede o LLM real com ~15 mensagens ESCRITAS A MAO e SEM PII, antes de construir o agente em cima dele.

    make smoke-llm                 # precisa de ANTHROPIC_API_KEY no ambiente ou em .env (ignorado pelo git)
    make smoke-llm-dry             # encanamento completo com um LLM de mentira, sem chave e sem rede

O que mede (docs/PLAN.md, secao 5.4): latencia por chamada e o p95 do TURNO projetado a partir dela, tokens/s, `usage`, saida estruturada
valida, precisao de extracao separando erro SILENCIOSO de omissao, aprovacao do guardrail, tamanho do reply (alvo de 40 palavras),
divergencia regex vs LLM (decide o fast-path) e custo.

Garantias: (1) cada mensagem e `hand-written`; (2) o detector de PII roda em TODO payload antes do envio e a execucao ABORTA se achar algo;
(3) este script nao tem acesso ao dataset; (4) a chave nunca e impressa nem gravada. O relatorio vai para var/smoke/ (ignorado pelo git).

15 mensagens NAO certificam taxas: o smoke e um alarme contra problemas grosseiros, nao um benchmark.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
import re
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
from analysis import cost_model  # noqa: E402
from analysis.e2e_latency_sim import derive_llm_call_limit, project_turn_p95  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro import budgets  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.facts import FactBase, strip_accents  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.fastpath import fast_extract  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.guardrail import check_reply  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.claude import ClaudeLLM, LLMResult, Usage  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.prompt import build_system_prompt, build_user_message  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.schema import SlotValue, TurnOutput  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.pii import find_pii  # noqa: E402
from tools.smoke_messages import MESSAGES, SMOKE_TODAY, SmokeMessage  # noqa: E402

MODEL_PRICE_KEY = {"claude-haiku-5-5": "haiku-5-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5": "sonnet-5-5", "claude-opus-5-5": "opus-5-5"}


class UnsafePayload(RuntimeError):
    """Algo que parece PII ou segredo estava prestes a sair da maquina. Nada foi enviado."""


def assert_safe_to_send(*texts: str) -> None:
    kinds = sorted({k for t in texts for k in find_pii(t)})
    if kinds:
        raise UnsafePayload(f"PII/segredo detectado ({', '.join(kinds)}); nada foi enviado")


def load_env(path: Path) -> None:
    """Le KEY=VALUE de um .env sem sobrescrever o que ja esta no ambiente. Nunca imprime valores."""
    if not path.exists():
        return
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        value = value.strip().strip("'\"")
        if value:
            os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value)


def load_fact_base() -> FactBase:
    return FactBase.from_planos(json.loads((ROOT / "vendor" / "quote-service" / "data" / "plans.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))


def norm(slot: str, value: str) -> str:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", value)
    if slot in ("idade", "veiculo_ano"):
        return str(int(digits)) if digits else value.strip().lower()
    if slot == "cep":
        return digits
    return value.strip().lower()


# --- LLM de mentira (--dry-run e testes) --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class DryRunLLM:
    """Responde com o gabarito, so para provar o encanamento. Os numeros que ele gera NAO valem nada."""

    def __init__(self, model: str, fact_base: FactBase, seed: int = 1) -> None:
        self.model, self.system_prompt = model, build_system_prompt(fact_base)
        self._rng = random.Random(seed)
        self._by_text = {m.text: m for m in MESSAGES}

    def turn(self, user_message: str) -> LLMResult:
        msg = next((m for t, m in self._by_text.items() if user_message.endswith(t)), None)
        assert msg is not None, "mensagem desconhecida no dry-run"
        slots = [SlotValue(s, v, False) for s, v in msg.expected.items()] + [SlotValue(s, "?", True) for s in msg.expect_ambiguous]
        carencia = "carencia" in msg.must_cite
        reply = ("Roubo e furto só passam a valer 30 dias depois do início da vigência." if carencia else "Anotado! Pode me contar mais um pouco?")
        out = TurnOutput(tuple(slots), sorted(msg.intents)[0], ("carencia",) if carencia else (), reply)
        latency = self._rng.lognormvariate(math.log(0.9), 0.4)
        return LLMResult(out, None, latency, Usage(2400, 130), "end_turn")


# --- execucao e pontuacao ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class CallRecord:
    msg_id: str
    model: str
    repeat: int
    warmup: bool
    error: str | None
    latency_s: float
    usage: dict | None
    output: dict | None
    score: dict


def score_call(msg: SmokeMessage, res: LLMResult, base: FactBase) -> dict:
    s: dict = {"valid": res.output is not None}
    if res.output is None:
        return s
    out, wrong_silent, kinds = res.output, 0, {}
    ambiguous = out.ambiguous()
    for slot, want in msg.expected.items():
        got = out.entries(slot)
        if not got:
            kinds[slot] = "omitted"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "correct"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want):
            kinds[slot] = "correct_flagged"
        elif slot in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "wrong_flagged"
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_WRONG"
            wrong_silent += 1
    for slot in msg.expect_ambiguous:
        if out.entries(slot) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_VALUE_ON_AMBIGUOUS"
            wrong_silent += 1
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "ok_flagged_or_absent"
    for slot in {e.slot for e in out.slots} - set(msg.expected) - set(msg.expect_ambiguous):
        if slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_EXTRA"
            wrong_silent += 1
    lead_texts = [t for role, t in msg.history if role == "lead"] + [msg.text] + [f"{k} {v}" for k, v in msg.known_slots.items()]
    violations = check_reply(out.reply, facts_used=out.facts_used, base=base, lead_texts=lead_texts)
    plain = strip_accents(out.reply).lower()
    fast = fast_extract(msg.asked_slot, msg.text, today=SMOKE_TODAY)
    llm_value = out.value(msg.asked_slot) if msg.asked_slot else None
    s.update(slot_outcomes=kinds, silent_wrong=wrong_silent, intent_ok=out.intent in msg.intents,
             guardrail_ok=not violations, violations=sorted({v.rule for v in violations}),
             forbidden_leak=[f for f in msg.forbidden_in_reply if strip_accents(f).lower() in plain],
             cited_required=set(msg.must_cite) <= set(out.facts_used), reply_words=len(out.reply.split()),
             fast_value=fast, fast_diverges=bool(fast is not None and (llm_value is None or norm(msg.asked_slot, llm_value) != norm(msg.asked_slot, fast))))
    return s


def run_model(llm, base: FactBase, messages, repeats: int) -> list[CallRecord]:
    """Uma chamada de aquecimento (a 1a com um esquema novo paga compilacao) fica FORA das estatisticas."""
    records: list[CallRecord] = []
    plan = [(messages[0], 0, True)] + [(m, r, False) for r in range(1, repeats + 1) for m in messages]
    for msg, rep, warm in plan:
        user = build_user_message(today=SMOKE_TODAY, known_slots=msg.known_slots, asked_slot=msg.asked_slot, history=msg.history, message=msg.text)
        assert msg.source == "hand-written", f"{msg.id}: so mensagens escritas a mao podem sair da maquina"
        assert_safe_to_send(llm.system_prompt, user)
        res = llm.turn(user)
        records.append(CallRecord(msg.id, llm.model, rep, warm, res.error, res.latency_s,
                                  None if res.usage is None else res.usage.__dict__,
                                  None if res.output is None else {"slots": [s.__dict__ for s in res.output.slots], "intent": res.output.intent,
                                                                   "facts_used": list(res.output.facts_used), "reply": res.output.reply},
                                  score_call(msg, res, base)))
    return records


def pct(xs: list[float], p: float) -> float:
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p / 100 * len(xs)))] if xs else float("nan")


def summarize(records: list[CallRecord], model: str) -> dict:
    rs = [r for r in records if not r.warmup]
    ok = [r for r in rs if r.score.get("valid")]
    lat = [r.latency_s for r in rs if r.error is None]
    words = [r.score["reply_words"] for r in ok]
    usage = [r.usage for r in rs if r.usage]
    price = cost_model.PRICES.get(MODEL_PRICE_KEY.get(model, ""), None)
    per_call_usd = None
    if price and usage:
        per_call_usd = sum((u["input_tokens"] * price["inp"] + u["cache_read_tokens"] * price["inp"] * price["read"]
                            + u["cache_write_tokens"] * price["inp"] * cost_model.WRITE_5M + u["output_tokens"] * price["out"]) / 1e6
                           for u in usage) / len(usage)
    fast_applies = [r for r in ok if r.score["fast_value"] is not None]
    projection = project_turn_p95(lat) if lat else None
    s = {
        "model": model, "calls": len(rs), "errors": sorted({r.error for r in rs if r.error}),
        "warmup_latency_s": next((round(r.latency_s, 2) for r in records if r.warmup), None),
        "latency_s": {"p50": round(pct(lat, 50), 2), "p95": round(pct(lat, 95), 2), "p99": round(pct(lat, 99), 2), "max": round(max(lat), 2)} if lat else None,
        "projected_turn_p95_s": projection,
        "mean_input_tokens": round(sum(u["input_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_output_tokens": round(sum(u["output_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_cache_read_tokens": round(sum(u["cache_read_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "output_tokens_per_s": round(sum(r.usage["output_tokens"] / r.latency_s for r in rs if r.usage and r.latency_s) / max(1, len(usage)), 1) if usage else None,
        "usd_per_call": None if per_call_usd is None else round(per_call_usd, 6),
        "valid_output_rate": round(len(ok) / len(rs), 3) if rs else 0.0,
        "silent_wrong": sum(r.score["silent_wrong"] for r in ok),
        "omissions": sum(v == "omitted" for r in ok for v in r.score["slot_outcomes"].values()),
        "intent_accuracy": round(sum(r.score["intent_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_pass_rate": round(sum(r.score["guardrail_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_violations": {rule: sum(rule in r.score["violations"] for r in ok) for rule in sorted({v for r in ok for v in r.score["violations"]})},
        "forbidden_leaks": sum(len(r.score["forbidden_leak"]) for r in ok),
        "required_fact_cited": all(r.score["cited_required"] for r in ok),
        "reply_words": {"mean": round(sum(words) / len(words), 1), "p95": pct(words, 95), "max": max(words),
                        "share_le_target": round(sum(w <= budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS for w in words) / len(words), 3)} if words else None,
        "fast_path": {"applicable_calls": len(fast_applies), "abstained_calls": len(ok) - len(fast_applies),
                      "divergences": sum(r.score["fast_diverges"] for r in ok)},
    }
    lim = derive_llm_call_limit(n=15_000)
    s["derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s"] = lim["binding_llm_call_p95_max_s"]
    s["checks"] = {
        "0 extracoes erradas em silencio": s["silent_wrong"] == 0,
        "saida estruturada valida em 100%": s["valid_output_rate"] == 1.0,
        f"p95 projetado do turno sem cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["no_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S),
        f"p95 projetado do turno com cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["with_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S),
        "guardrail aprova >= 80% dos replies": s["guardrail_pass_rate"] >= 0.8,
        f"reply curto: >= 90% com <= {budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS} palavras e nenhum acima de {budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS}":
            bool(words) and s["reply_words"]["share_le_target"] >= 0.9 and max(words) <= budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS,
        "nenhum reply com termo proibido": s["forbidden_leaks"] == 0,
    }
    s["passes"] = all(s["checks"].values())
    s["fast_path_verdict"] = "REMOVER (divergiu do LLM)" if s["fast_path"]["divergences"] else "sem divergencia nesta amostra (ainda precisa de ganho medido para ligar)"
    return s


def print_report(summaries: list[dict], dry: bool) -> None:
    if dry:
        print("\n*** DRY-RUN: LLM de mentira. Estes numeros provam o ENCANAMENTO e nao valem nada como medicao. ***")
    for s in summaries:
        print(f"\n=== {s['model']} | {s['calls']} chamadas (aquecimento {s['warmup_latency_s']}s, fora das estatisticas)")
        if s["latency_s"]:
            l, p = s["latency_s"], s["projected_turn_p95_s"]
            print(f"  latencia por chamada  p50 {l['p50']}s  p95 {l['p95']}s  p99 {l['p99']}s  max {l['max']}s   (limite derivado do criterio: p95 <= {s['derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s']}s)")
            print(f"  p95 do TURNO projetado  sem cotacao {p['no_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)   com cotacao {p['with_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)")
        print(f"  tokens medios  entrada {s['mean_input_tokens']}  saida {s['mean_output_tokens']}  saida/s {s['output_tokens_per_s']}   US$/chamada {s['usd_per_call']}")
        print(f"  extracao  erros silenciosos {s['silent_wrong']}   omissoes {s['omissions']}   intent {s['intent_accuracy']}   saida valida {s['valid_output_rate']}")
        print(f"  guardrail aprova {s['guardrail_pass_rate']}  violacoes {s['guardrail_violations']}   reply {s['reply_words']}")
        print(f"  fast-path {s['fast_path']}  ->  {s['fast_path_verdict']}")
        for name, ok in s["checks"].items():
            print(f"    [{'ok' if ok else 'FALHA'}] {name}")
        print(f"  VEREDITO: {'PASSA' if s['passes'] else 'NAO PASSA'}   (15 mensagens: alarme, nao benchmark)")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--models", default="claude-haiku-5-5,claude-sonnet-5-5")
    ap.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--prompt-cache", action="store_true", help="liga cache_control no prefixo estatico (desligado por padrao)")
    ap.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "var" / "smoke")
    ap.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="so para testes: aponta o SDK para um servidor local")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    base = load_fact_base()
    load_env(ROOT / ".env")
    if not a.dry_run and not os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"):
        print("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ausente. Copie .env.example para .env e preencha, ou rode `make smoke-llm-dry`.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    models = [m.strip() for m in a.models.split(",") if m.strip()]
    all_records: dict[str, list[CallRecord]] = {}
    summaries = []
    try:
        for model in models:
            llm = DryRunLLM(model, base) if a.dry_run else ClaudeLLM(model, base, prompt_cache=a.prompt_cache, base_url=a.base_url)
            all_records[model] = run_model(llm, base, MESSAGES, a.repeats)
            summaries.append(summarize(all_records[model], model))
    except UnsafePayload as exc:
        print(f"ABORTADO: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    print_report(summaries, a.dry_run)
    a.out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + ("-dry" if a.dry_run else "")
    path = a.out_dir / f"smoke-{stamp}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps({"dry_run": a.dry_run, "today": SMOKE_TODAY.isoformat(), "summaries": summaries,
                                "calls": [r.__dict__ for rs in all_records.values() for r in rs]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nrelatorio completo (com cada reply, para ler a olho): {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    return 0 if all(s["passes"] for s in summaries) or a.dry_run else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""smoke-llm: mede o LLM real com ~15 mensagens ESCRITAS A MAO e SEM PII, antes de construir o agente em cima dele.

    make smoke-llm                 # precisa de ANTHROPIC_API_KEY no ambiente ou em .env (ignorado pelo git)
    make smoke-llm-dry             # encanamento completo com um LLM de mentira, sem chave e sem rede

O que mede (docs/PLAN.md, secao 5.4): latencia por chamada e o p95 do TURNO projetado a partir dela, tokens/s, `usage`, saida estruturada
valida, precisao de extracao separando erro SILENCIOSO de omissao, aprovacao do guardrail, tamanho do reply (alvo de 40 palavras),
divergencia regex vs LLM (decide o fast-path) e custo.

Garantias: (1) cada mensagem e `hand-written`; (2) o detector de PII roda em TODO payload antes do envio e a execucao ABORTA se achar algo;
(3) este script nao tem acesso ao dataset; (4) a chave nunca e impressa nem gravada. O relatorio vai para var/smoke/ (ignorado pelo git).

15 mensagens NAO certificam taxas: o smoke e um alarme contra problemas grosseiros, nao um benchmark.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
import re
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
from analysis import cost_model  # noqa: E402
from analysis.e2e_latency_sim import derive_llm_call_limit, project_turn_p95  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro import budgets  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.facts import FactBase, strip_accents  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.fastpath import fast_extract  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.guardrail import check_reply  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.claude import ClaudeLLM, LLMResult, Usage  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.prompt import build_system_prompt, build_user_message  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.llm.schema import SlotValue, TurnOutput  # noqa: E402
from autoseguro.pii import find_pii  # noqa: E402
from tools.smoke_messages import MESSAGES, SMOKE_TODAY, SmokeMessage  # noqa: E402

MODEL_PRICE_KEY = {"claude-haiku-5-5": "haiku-5-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5": "sonnet-5-5", "claude-opus-5-5": "opus-5-5"}


class UnsafePayload(RuntimeError):
    """Algo que parece PII ou segredo estava prestes a sair da maquina. Nada foi enviado."""


def assert_safe_to_send(*texts: str) -> None:
    kinds = sorted({k for t in texts for k in find_pii(t)})
    if kinds:
        raise UnsafePayload(f"PII/segredo detectado ({', '.join(kinds)}); nada foi enviado")


def load_env(path: Path) -> None:
    """Le KEY=VALUE de um .env sem sobrescrever o que ja esta no ambiente. Nunca imprime valores."""
    if not path.exists():
        return
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        value = value.strip().strip("'\"")
        if value:
            os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value)


def load_fact_base() -> FactBase:
    return FactBase.from_planos(json.loads((ROOT / "vendor" / "quote-service" / "data" / "plans.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))


def norm(slot: str, value: str) -> str:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", value)
    if slot in ("idade", "veiculo_ano"):
        return str(int(digits)) if digits else value.strip().lower()
    if slot == "cep":
        return digits
    return value.strip().lower()


# --- LLM de mentira (--dry-run e testes) --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class DryRunLLM:
    """Responde com o gabarito, so para provar o encanamento. Os numeros que ele gera NAO valem nada."""

    def __init__(self, model: str, fact_base: FactBase, seed: int = 1) -> None:
        self.model, self.system_prompt = model, build_system_prompt(fact_base)
        self._rng = random.Random(seed)
        self._by_text = {m.text: m for m in MESSAGES}

    def turn(self, user_message: str) -> LLMResult:
        msg = next((m for t, m in self._by_text.items() if user_message.endswith(t)), None)
        assert msg is not None, "mensagem desconhecida no dry-run"
        slots = [SlotValue(s, v, False) for s, v in msg.expected.items()] + [SlotValue(s, "?", True) for s in msg.expect_ambiguous]
        carencia = "carencia" in msg.must_cite
        reply = ("Roubo e furto só passam a valer 30 dias depois do início da vigência." if carencia else "Anotado! Pode me contar mais um pouco?")
        out = TurnOutput(tuple(slots), sorted(msg.intents)[0], ("carencia",) if carencia else (), reply)
        latency = self._rng.lognormvariate(math.log(0.9), 0.4)
        return LLMResult(out, None, latency, Usage(2400, 130), "end_turn")


# --- execucao e pontuacao ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class CallRecord:
    msg_id: str
    model: str
    repeat: int
    warmup: bool
    error: str | None
    latency_s: float
    usage: dict | None
    output: dict | None
    score: dict


def score_call(msg: SmokeMessage, res: LLMResult, base: FactBase) -> dict:
    s: dict = {"valid": res.output is not None}
    if res.output is None:
        return s
    out, wrong_silent, kinds = res.output, 0, {}
    ambiguous = out.ambiguous()
    for slot, want in msg.expected.items():
        got = out.entries(slot)
        if not got:
            kinds[slot] = "omitted"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "correct"
        elif norm(slot, got[0].value) == norm(slot, want):
            kinds[slot] = "correct_flagged"
        elif slot in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "wrong_flagged"
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_WRONG"
            wrong_silent += 1
    for slot in msg.expect_ambiguous:
        if out.entries(slot) and slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_VALUE_ON_AMBIGUOUS"
            wrong_silent += 1
        else:
            kinds[slot] = "ok_flagged_or_absent"
    for slot in {e.slot for e in out.slots} - set(msg.expected) - set(msg.expect_ambiguous):
        if slot not in ambiguous:
            kinds[slot] = "SILENT_EXTRA"
            wrong_silent += 1
    lead_texts = [t for role, t in msg.history if role == "lead"] + [msg.text] + [f"{k} {v}" for k, v in msg.known_slots.items()]
    violations = check_reply(out.reply, facts_used=out.facts_used, base=base, lead_texts=lead_texts)
    plain = strip_accents(out.reply).lower()
    fast = fast_extract(msg.asked_slot, msg.text, today=SMOKE_TODAY)
    llm_value = out.value(msg.asked_slot) if msg.asked_slot else None
    s.update(slot_outcomes=kinds, silent_wrong=wrong_silent, intent_ok=out.intent in msg.intents,
             guardrail_ok=not violations, violations=sorted({v.rule for v in violations}),
             forbidden_leak=[f for f in msg.forbidden_in_reply if strip_accents(f).lower() in plain],
             cited_required=set(msg.must_cite) <= set(out.facts_used), reply_words=len(out.reply.split()),
             fast_value=fast, fast_diverges=bool(fast is not None and (llm_value is None or norm(msg.asked_slot, llm_value) != norm(msg.asked_slot, fast))))
    return s


def run_model(llm, base: FactBase, messages, repeats: int) -> list[CallRecord]:
    """Uma chamada de aquecimento (a 1a com um esquema novo paga compilacao) fica FORA das estatisticas."""
    records: list[CallRecord] = []
    plan = [(messages[0], 0, True)] + [(m, r, False) for r in range(1, repeats + 1) for m in messages]
    for msg, rep, warm in plan:
        user = build_user_message(today=SMOKE_TODAY, known_slots=msg.known_slots, asked_slot=msg.asked_slot, history=msg.history, message=msg.text)
        assert msg.source == "hand-written", f"{msg.id}: so mensagens escritas a mao podem sair da maquina"
        assert_safe_to_send(llm.system_prompt, user)
        res = llm.turn(user)
        records.append(CallRecord(msg.id, llm.model, rep, warm, res.error, res.latency_s,
                                  None if res.usage is None else res.usage.__dict__,
                                  None if res.output is None else {"slots": [s.__dict__ for s in res.output.slots], "intent": res.output.intent,
                                                                   "facts_used": list(res.output.facts_used), "reply": res.output.reply},
                                  score_call(msg, res, base)))
    return records


def pct(xs: list[float], p: float) -> float:
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p / 100 * len(xs)))] if xs else float("nan")


def summarize(records: list[CallRecord], model: str) -> dict:
    rs = [r for r in records if not r.warmup]
    ok = [r for r in rs if r.score.get("valid")]
    lat = [r.latency_s for r in rs if r.error is None]
    words = [r.score["reply_words"] for r in ok]
    usage = [r.usage for r in rs if r.usage]
    price = cost_model.PRICES.get(MODEL_PRICE_KEY.get(model, ""), None)
    per_call_usd = None
    if price and usage:
        per_call_usd = sum((u["input_tokens"] * price["inp"] + u["cache_read_tokens"] * price["inp"] * price["read"]
                            + u["cache_write_tokens"] * price["inp"] * cost_model.WRITE_5M + u["output_tokens"] * price["out"]) / 1e6
                           for u in usage) / len(usage)
    fast_applies = [r for r in ok if r.score["fast_value"] is not None]
    projection = project_turn_p95(lat) if lat else None
    s = {
        "model": model, "calls": len(rs), "errors": sorted({r.error for r in rs if r.error}),
        "warmup_latency_s": next((round(r.latency_s, 2) for r in records if r.warmup), None),
        "latency_s": {"p50": round(pct(lat, 50), 2), "p95": round(pct(lat, 95), 2), "p99": round(pct(lat, 99), 2), "max": round(max(lat), 2)} if lat else None,
        "projected_turn_p95_s": projection,
        "mean_input_tokens": round(sum(u["input_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_output_tokens": round(sum(u["output_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "mean_cache_read_tokens": round(sum(u["cache_read_tokens"] for u in usage) / len(usage)) if usage else None,
        "output_tokens_per_s": round(sum(r.usage["output_tokens"] / r.latency_s for r in rs if r.usage and r.latency_s) / max(1, len(usage)), 1) if usage else None,
        "usd_per_call": None if per_call_usd is None else round(per_call_usd, 6),
        "valid_output_rate": round(len(ok) / len(rs), 3) if rs else 0.0,
        "silent_wrong": sum(r.score["silent_wrong"] for r in ok),
        "omissions": sum(v == "omitted" for r in ok for v in r.score["slot_outcomes"].values()),
        "intent_accuracy": round(sum(r.score["intent_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_pass_rate": round(sum(r.score["guardrail_ok"] for r in ok) / len(ok), 3) if ok else 0.0,
        "guardrail_violations": {rule: sum(rule in r.score["violations"] for r in ok) for rule in sorted({v for r in ok for v in r.score["violations"]})},
        "forbidden_leaks": sum(len(r.score["forbidden_leak"]) for r in ok),
        "required_fact_cited": all(r.score["cited_required"] for r in ok),
        "reply_words": {"mean": round(sum(words) / len(words), 1), "p95": pct(words, 95), "max": max(words),
                        "share_le_target": round(sum(w <= budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS for w in words) / len(words), 3)} if words else None,
        "fast_path": {"applicable_calls": len(fast_applies), "abstained_calls": len(ok) - len(fast_applies),
                      "divergences": sum(r.score["fast_diverges"] for r in ok)},
    }
    lim = derive_llm_call_limit(n=15_000)
    s["derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s"] = lim["binding_llm_call_p95_max_s"]
    s["checks"] = {
        "0 extracoes erradas em silencio": s["silent_wrong"] == 0,
        "saida estruturada valida em 100%": s["valid_output_rate"] == 1.0,
        f"p95 projetado do turno sem cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["no_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S),
        f"p95 projetado do turno com cotacao <= {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s": bool(projection and projection["with_quote_p95_s"] <= budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S),
        "guardrail aprova >= 80% dos replies": s["guardrail_pass_rate"] >= 0.8,
        f"reply curto: >= 90% com <= {budgets.REPLY_TARGET_WORDS} palavras e nenhum acima de {budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS}":
            bool(words) and s["reply_words"]["share_le_target"] >= 0.9 and max(words) <= budgets.REPLY_HARD_MAX_WORDS,
        "nenhum reply com termo proibido": s["forbidden_leaks"] == 0,
    }
    s["passes"] = all(s["checks"].values())
    s["fast_path_verdict"] = "REMOVER (divergiu do LLM)" if s["fast_path"]["divergences"] else "sem divergencia nesta amostra (ainda precisa de ganho medido para ligar)"
    return s


def print_report(summaries: list[dict], dry: bool) -> None:
    if dry:
        print("\n*** DRY-RUN: LLM de mentira. Estes numeros provam o ENCANAMENTO e nao valem nada como medicao. ***")
    for s in summaries:
        print(f"\n=== {s['model']} | {s['calls']} chamadas (aquecimento {s['warmup_latency_s']}s, fora das estatisticas)")
        if s["latency_s"]:
            l, p = s["latency_s"], s["projected_turn_p95_s"]
            print(f"  latencia por chamada  p50 {l['p50']}s  p95 {l['p95']}s  p99 {l['p99']}s  max {l['max']}s   (limite derivado do criterio: p95 <= {s['derived_llm_call_limit_p95_s']}s)")
            print(f"  p95 do TURNO projetado  sem cotacao {p['no_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_NO_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)   com cotacao {p['with_quote_p95_s']}s (criterio {budgets.TURN_P95_WITH_QUOTE_S:.0f}s)")
        print(f"  tokens medios  entrada {s['mean_input_tokens']}  saida {s['mean_output_tokens']}  saida/s {s['output_tokens_per_s']}   US$/chamada {s['usd_per_call']}")
        print(f"  extracao  erros silenciosos {s['silent_wrong']}   omissoes {s['omissions']}   intent {s['intent_accuracy']}   saida valida {s['valid_output_rate']}")
        print(f"  guardrail aprova {s['guardrail_pass_rate']}  violacoes {s['guardrail_violations']}   reply {s['reply_words']}")
        print(f"  fast-path {s['fast_path']}  ->  {s['fast_path_verdict']}")
        for name, ok in s["checks"].items():
            print(f"    [{'ok' if ok else 'FALHA'}] {name}")
        print(f"  VEREDITO: {'PASSA' if s['passes'] else 'NAO PASSA'}   (15 mensagens: alarme, nao benchmark)")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--models", default="claude-haiku-5-5,claude-sonnet-5-5")
    ap.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--prompt-cache", action="store_true", help="liga cache_control no prefixo estatico (desligado por padrao)")
    ap.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT / "var" / "smoke")
    ap.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="so para testes: aponta o SDK para um servidor local")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    base = load_fact_base()
    load_env(ROOT / ".env")
    if not a.dry_run and not os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"):
        print("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ausente. Copie .env.example para .env e preencha, ou rode `make smoke-llm-dry`.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    models = [m.strip() for m in a.models.split(",") if m.strip()]
    all_records: dict[str, list[CallRecord]] = {}
    summaries = []
    try:
        for model in models:
            llm = DryRunLLM(model, base) if a.dry_run else ClaudeLLM(model, base, prompt_cache=a.prompt_cache, base_url=a.base_url)
            all_records[model] = run_model(llm, base, MESSAGES, a.repeats)
            summaries.append(summarize(all_records[model], model))
    except UnsafePayload as exc:
        print(f"ABORTADO: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    print_report(summaries, a.dry_run)
    a.out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + ("-dry" if a.dry_run else "")
    path = a.out_dir / f"smoke-{stamp}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps({"dry_run": a.dry_run, "today": SMOKE_TODAY.isoformat(), "summaries": summaries,
                                "calls": [r.__dict__ for rs in all_records.values() for r in rs]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nrelatorio completo (com cada reply, para ler a olho): {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    return 0 if all(s["passes"] for s in summaries) or a.dry_run else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Esquema da saida estruturada, prompt e fast-path estrito."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from autoseguro import budgets
from autoseguro.facts import FactBase
from autoseguro.fastpath import fast_extract
from autoseguro.llm.prompt import build_system_prompt, build_user_message
from autoseguro.llm.schema import INTENTS, SLOT_NAMES, OutputError, SlotValue, TurnOutput, parse_turn_output, response_schema
from autoseguro.pii import find_pii

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BASE = FactBase.from_planos(json.loads((ROOT / "vendor" / "quote-service" / "data" / "plans.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
TODAY = date(2026, 10, 21)

UNSUPPORTED = {"minLength", "maxLength", "minimum", "maximum", "multipleOf", "minItems", "maxItems", "pattern", "format"}


def _walk(node):
    yield node
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        for v in node.values():
            yield from _walk(v)

"""smoke-llm: as mensagens, o gate de PII, a pontuacao e o relatorio. O smoke tem que saber REPROVAR, nao so passar."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

import pytest

from autoseguro import budgets
from autoseguro.llm.claude import LLMResult, Usage
from autoseguro.llm.schema import SlotValue, TurnOutput
from autoseguro.pii import find_pii
from tools import smoke_llm
from tools.smoke_llm import CallRecord, DryRunLLM, UnsafePayload, assert_safe_to_send, load_env, run_model, score_call, summarize
from tools.smoke_messages import MESSAGES, SMOKE_TODAY, SmokeMessage

BASE = smoke_llm.load_fact_base()
BY_ID = {m.id: m for m in MESSAGES}


# --- as mensagens --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_there_are_fifteen_hand_written_messages_with_a_unique_id():
    assert len(MESSAGES) == 15 and len({m.id for m in MESSAGES}) == 15
    assert all(m.source == "hand-written" for m in MESSAGES)


def test_no_message_carries_pii_in_any_field():
    for m in MESSAGES:
        blob = " ".join([m.text, *(t for _, t in m.history), *m.known_slots.values()])
        assert find_pii(blob) == [], m.id
        assert not re.search(r"\b[0-9]{3}\.?[0-9]{3}\.?[0-9]{3}-?[0-9]{2}\b", blob), f"{m.id}: nada com cara de CPF"


def test_every_message_has_its_answer_key_written_with_it():
    for m in MESSAGES:
        assert m.intents, m.id
    assert sum(1 for m in MESSAGES if m.expect_ambiguous) >= 4, "os casos de erro silencioso plausivel sao o ponto do smoke"
    assert sum(1 for m in MESSAGES if m.asked_slot and m.expected) >= 3, "precisa de respostas diretas para medir o fast-path"
    assert any("carencia" in m.must_cite for m in MESSAGES) and any(m.forbidden_in_reply for m in MESSAGES)


# --- o gate: nada sai sem passar pelo detector -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_gate_blocks_pii_and_secrets_and_lets_clean_text_through():
    assert_safe_to_send("tenho 42 anos, o cep é 01310-100")
    for leak in ("fale com " + "joao" + "@" + "gmail.com", "cpf " + "111.222" + ".333-44", "/Users" + "/fulano/x", "sk-ant" + "-abcdefgh12"):
        with pytest.raises(UnsafePayload):
            assert_safe_to_send("texto limpo", leak)


class SpyLLM:
    def __init__(self, system_prompt="sistema limpo"):
        self.model, self.system_prompt, self.calls = "spy", system_prompt, 0

    def turn(self, user_message):
        self.calls += 1
        raise AssertionError("nao deveria ter sido chamado")


def test_run_aborts_BEFORE_any_call_when_a_message_has_pii():
    leaky = SmokeMessage("x", "meu email é " + "a" + "@" + "b.com.br")
    spy = SpyLLM()
    with pytest.raises(UnsafePayload):
        run_model(spy, BASE, [leaky], 1)
    assert spy.calls == 0


def test_run_aborts_before_any_call_when_the_system_prompt_has_pii():
    spy = SpyLLM(system_prompt="regra " + "111.222" + ".333-44")
    with pytest.raises(UnsafePayload):
        run_model(spy, BASE, MESSAGES, 1)
    assert spy.calls == 0


def test_run_refuses_a_message_that_is_not_hand_written():
    spy = SpyLLM()
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="escritas a mao"):
        run_model(spy, BASE, [SmokeMessage("x", "oi", source="dataset")], 1)
    assert spy.calls == 0


def test_the_smoke_has_no_access_to_the_dataset():
    src = (smoke_llm.ROOT / "tools" / "smoke_llm.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "DATASET_PATH" not in src and "parquet" not in src.lower() and "conversations" not in src


# --- pontuacao: erro silencioso e o pior caso -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def result(*slots, intent="provide_info", reply="Anotado!", facts=(), error=None):
    out = TurnOutput(tuple(SlotValue(*s) for s in slots), intent, tuple(facts), reply)
    return LLMResult(None if error else out, error, 1.0, Usage(2400, 130), "end_turn")


def test_a_wrong_value_without_a_flag_is_a_SILENT_error():
    s = score_call(BY_ID["m02_ano_direto"], result(("veiculo_ano", "2016", False)), BASE)
    assert s["silent_wrong"] == 1 and s["slot_outcomes"]["veiculo_ano"] == "SILENT_WRONG"


def test_a_wrong_value_that_the_model_flagged_is_safe_and_an_omission_is_not_silent():
    flagged = score_call(BY_ID["m02_ano_direto"], result(("veiculo_ano", "2016", True)), BASE)
    omitted = score_call(BY_ID["m02_ano_direto"], result(), BASE)
    assert flagged["silent_wrong"] == 0 and flagged["slot_outcomes"]["veiculo_ano"] == "wrong_flagged"
    assert omitted["silent_wrong"] == 0 and omitted["slot_outcomes"]["veiculo_ano"] == "omitted"


def test_correct_value_is_correct():
    s = score_call(BY_ID["m04_cep_direto"], result(("cep", "01310-100", False)), BASE)
    assert s["silent_wrong"] == 0 and s["slot_outcomes"]["cep"] == "correct"  # 01310-100 == 01310100 depois de normalizar


def test_a_confident_value_on_an_ambiguous_message_is_a_silent_error():
    """m08: '2015 mas o modelo e 2016'. Escolher um em silencio muda o preco."""
    m = BY_ID["m08_ano_versus_modelo"]

    assert score_call(m, result(("veiculo_ano", "2015", True)), BASE)["silent_wrong"] == 0
    assert score_call(m, result(("veiculo_ano", "2015", False), ("veiculo_ano", "2016", False)), BASE)["silent_wrong"] == 0  # conflito = incerteza
    assert score_call(m, result(), BASE)["silent_wrong"] == 0

    m = BY_ID["m09_ano_de_nascimento"]

    assert score_call(m, result(("idade", "1990", True)), BASE)["silent_wrong"] == 0

    assert s["silent_wrong"] == 1 and s["slot_outcomes"]["idade"] == "SILENT_EXTRA"


def test_guardrail_and_forbidden_terms_are_scored():
    bad = score_call(BY_ID["m11_objecao_de_preco"], result(intent="price_objection", reply="Consigo um desconto de R$ 20 para você"), BASE)
    assert not bad["guardrail_ok"] and bad["forbidden_leak"] and {"R1_dinheiro", "R4_desconto_ou_condicao"} <= set(bad["violations"])
    good = score_call(BY_ID["m11_objecao_de_preco"], result(intent="price_objection", reply="Entendo! Quer ver outra opção de plano?"), BASE)
    assert good["guardrail_ok"] and not good["forbidden_leak"] and good["intent_ok"]


def test_the_carencia_message_must_cite_the_carencia_fact():
    m = BY_ID["m10_duvida_de_carencia"]
    reply = "Roubo e furto só passam a valer 30 dias depois do início da vigência."
    assert score_call(m, result(intent="ask_coverage_question", reply=reply, facts=["carencia"]), BASE)["cited_required"]
    assert not score_call(m, result(intent="ask_coverage_question", reply=reply, facts=[]), BASE)["cited_required"]


def test_fast_path_divergence_is_detected_when_the_llm_disagrees_or_abstains():
    m = BY_ID["m02_ano_direto"]  # o regex responde 2015
    assert not score_call(m, result(("veiculo_ano", "2015", False)), BASE)["fast_diverges"]
    assert score_call(m, result(("veiculo_ano", "2016", False)), BASE)["fast_diverges"]
    assert score_call(m, result(), BASE)["fast_diverges"]  # o LLM nao se comprometeu, o regex teria se comprometido
    assert score_call(m, result(("veiculo_ano", "2015", True)), BASE)["fast_diverges"]
    abstains = score_call(BY_ID["m06_idade_aproximada"], result(("idade", "35", True)), BASE)
    assert abstains["fast_value"] is None and not abstains["fast_diverges"]


def test_an_invalid_output_is_scored_as_invalid_not_as_a_crash():

"""As analises rodam, reproduzem o que o PLAN/README afirmam e nao vazam texto do dataset."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import os
import random

import pytest

from analysis import cost_model, e2e_latency_sim, latency_sim


[EMAIL](scope="module")
def e2e():
    return e2e_latency_sim.run_all(n=20_000, seed=11)


[EMAIL](scope="module")
def sim():
    result = latency_sim.run_all(n=30_000, seed=7)
    return {(r["scenario"], r["policy"]): r for r in result["rows"]}


# --- latencia fim a fim ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_quote_turn_p95_is_dominated_by_the_quote_slow_mode_not_the_llm(e2e):
    """Tirar o LLM do caminho critico devolve exatamente o p95 da /quote; o LLM soma por cima ~1,1s (rapido) a ~2,5s (medio)."""
    quote_only = e2e["quote_only"]["nominal"]["p95_s"]
    for prof, margin in (("rapido", 3.0), ("medio", 4.5)):
        d = e2e["by_profile"]["nominal"][prof]
        assert d["quote_fast"]["p95_s"] == quote_only
        assert quote_only < d["quote"]["p95_s"] < quote_only + margin


def test_acceptance_criteria_break_where_the_plan_says(e2e):
    """Janelas robustas ao ruido de amostra (valores perto do limite nao sao assertados)."""
    sweep = {w["llm_p50_s"]: w for w in e2e["sweep"]}
    assert sweep[1.5]["c2_ok"] and sweep[1.5]["c3_ok"]
    assert sweep[2.0]["c3_ok"]
    assert not sweep[3.0]["c2_ok"] and not sweep[4.0]["c3_ok"]
    p95s = [w["llm_turn_p95_s"] for w in e2e["sweep"]]
    assert all(a <= b + 0.1 for a, b in zip(p95s, p95s[1:]))


def test_slow_llm_profile_fails_acceptance_and_fast_passes(e2e):
    nominal = e2e["by_profile"]["nominal"]
    assert nominal["rapido"]["llm"]["p95_s"] <= e2e_latency_sim.C2_P95 and nominal["rapido"]["quote"]["p95_s"] <= e2e_latency_sim.C3_P95
    assert nominal["lento"]["llm"]["p95_s"] > e2e_latency_sim.C2_P95


def test_a_short_reply_alone_does_not_rescue_the_medium_profile(e2e):
    """Ajuste 1: 'o perfil medio estourar 5s so vale como conclusao se o reply curto nao resolver'. O teto de 40 palavras NAO resolve sozinho;
    a lista compacta de slots aproxima, mas deixa o medio SEM margem (perto do criterio)."""
    ts = e2e["token_scenarios"]
    assert ts["so_slots_verboso"]["medio"]["meets_no_quote"], "antes de o LLM redigir a resposta, o medio cumpria"
    assert not ts["reply_sem_teto"]["medio"]["meets_no_quote"]
    assert not ts["reply_40_palavras"]["medio"]["meets_no_quote"]
    capped_only = ts["reply_40_palavras"]["medio"]["turn_no_quote_p95_s"]
    assert ts["reply_sem_teto"]["medio"]["turn_no_quote_p95_s"] - capped_only < 1.0, "o teto sozinho tira menos de 1s"
    compact = ts["reply_40_slots_compactos"]["medio"]["turn_no_quote_p95_s"]
    assert compact < capped_only - 2.0 and abs(compact - e2e_latency_sim.C2_P95) < 1.0, "compactar ajuda, mas o medio fica na fronteira"


def test_the_fast_profile_meets_the_criterion_in_every_output_scenario_with_margin(e2e):
    for row in e2e["token_scenarios"].values():
        assert row["rapido"]["meets_no_quote"] and row["rapido"]["meets_with_quote"]
        assert row["rapido"]["turn_no_quote_p95_s"] < e2e_latency_sim.C2_P95 - 1.5


def test_more_output_tokens_never_shorten_the_turn(e2e):
    ts = e2e["token_scenarios"]
    ordered = sorted(ts.values(), key=lambda r: r["out_tokens"])
    for prof in e2e_latency_sim.PROFILE_PARAMS:
        p95s = [r[prof]["turn_no_quote_p95_s"] for r in ordered]
        assert all(a <= b + 0.15 for a, b in zip(p95s, p95s[1:])), prof


def test_per_call_limit_is_derived_from_the_turn_criterion_not_picked(e2e):
    d = e2e["derived_llm_call_limit"]
    assert d["binding_turn"] == "no_quote_turn", "o criterio de 5s sem cotacao e o que manda"
    assert 4.0 <= d["binding_llm_call_p95_max_s"] <= 5.5
    assert d["binding_llm_call_p95_max_s"] == pytest.approx(min(d["no_quote_turn"]["llm_call_p95_max_s"], d["with_quote_turn"]["llm_call_p95_max_s"]))
    ok = [w["llm_p50_s"] for w in e2e["sweep"] if w["c2_ok"]]
    bad = [w["llm_p50_s"] for w in e2e["sweep"] if not w["c2_ok"]]
    assert max(ok) <= d["no_quote_turn"]["llm_call_p50_max_s"] + 0.1 and min(bad) >= d["no_quote_turn"]["llm_call_p50_max_s"] - 0.1, \
        "o limite derivado concorda com a varredura"


def test_projection_from_measured_latencies_matches_the_parametric_model(e2e):
    """`project_turn_p95` e o que o smoke usa: reamostra latencias MEDIDAS. Com amostras do mesmo perfil, reproduz o modelo."""
    p50, p95 = e2e_latency_sim.profile("rapido", e2e["assumptions"]["out_tokens"])
    rng = random.Random(3)
    lats = [rng.lognormvariate(math.log(p50), math.log(p95 / p50) / 1.645) for _ in range(3000)]
    proj = e2e_latency_sim.project_turn_p95(lats, n=20_000)
    d = e2e["by_profile"]["nominal"]["rapido"]
    assert abs(proj["no_quote_p95_s"] - d["llm"]["p95_s"]) < 0.4 and abs(proj["with_quote_p95_s"] - d["quote"]["p95_s"]) < 0.6


def test_projection_flags_a_slow_model():
    slow = e2e_latency_sim.project_turn_p95([6.5] * 50, n=5000)
    assert slow["no_quote_p95_s"] > e2e_latency_sim.C2_P95
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        e2e_latency_sim.project_turn_p95([])


def test_profiles_at_110_tokens_reproduce_the_previous_analysis():
    for name, (p50, p95) in {"rapido": (0.8, 2.0), "medio": (1.8, 4.5), "lento": (3.5, 9.0)}.items():
        got = e2e_latency_sim.profile(name, e2e_latency_sim.OUT_TOKENS["so_slots_verboso"])
        assert got[0] == pytest.approx(p50, abs=0.05) and got[1] == pytest.approx(p95, abs=0.3)


def test_strict_fast_path_buys_little_p95_with_a_fast_llm(e2e):
    """Por que o fast-path nasce desligado: com LLM rapido, cobrir 40% dos turnos rende menos de 1s no p95 por mensagem."""
    s = e2e["fast_share_sensitivity"]["rapido"]
    assert 0 <= s["0.0"] - s["0.4"] < 1.0


def test_mix_weights_sum_to_a_typical_conversation():
    for fs in (0.0, 0.3, 0.4):
        assert sum(e2e_latency_sim.mix_weights(fs).values()) == pytest.approx(e2e_latency_sim.TURNS_PER_CONVERSATION)


# --- custo ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_reply_in_the_llm_call_costs_about_a_third_more():
    ba = cost_model.run_all()["before_after_reply_in_llm"]
    assert ba and all(20 < v["delta_pct"] < 60 for v in ba.values())


def test_cache_break_even_matches_the_closed_form():
    h = cost_model.cache_break_even_hit_rate()
    assert h == pytest.approx(0.25 / 1.15)
    assert cost_model.call_usd("haiku-5-5", True, h) == pytest.approx(cost_model.call_usd("haiku-5-5", False))
    assert cost_model.call_usd("haiku-5-5", True, 0.95) < cost_model.call_usd("haiku-5-5", False)
    assert cost_model.call_usd("haiku-5-5", True, 0.0) > cost_model.call_usd("haiku-5-5", False)


def test_cost_ordering_and_linearity_in_calls():
    r = cost_model.run_all()["usd_per_conversation"]
    k = lambda s, c: r[f"{s} | {c} | sem cache | sem thinking"]  # noqa: E731
    c5, c8 = "com fast-path (5 chamadas)", "sem fast-path (8 chamadas)"
    assert k("haiku", c8) < k("haiku+sonnet", c8) < k("sonnet", c8) < k("opus", c8)
    assert k("haiku", c8) / k("haiku", c5) == pytest.approx(8 / 5, rel=0.01)


def test_verbose_slots_would_cost_more_than_the_compact_list():
    r = cost_model.run_all()
    assert r["sensitivity_verbose_slots_haiku_8_calls_no_cache_usd"] > r["usd_per_conversation"]["haiku | sem fast-path (8 chamadas) | sem cache | sem thinking"]


def test_prices_are_the_documented_ones():
    p = cost_model.PRICES
    assert (p["haiku-5-5"]["inp"], p["haiku-5-5"]["out"]) == (0.10, 0.50)
    assert (p["sonnet-5-5"]["inp"], p["sonnet-5-5"]["out"]) == (2.00, 10.00)


# --- politica de cotacao (simulador) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_latency_table_supports_policy_b(sim):
    a, b, c = (sim[("nominal", p)] for p in "ABC")
    assert b["p50_s"] < 0.5 and 7.9 <= b["p95_s"] <= 8.2
    assert b["no_quote_in_budget_pct"] < 0.5
    assert 1.20 <= b["calls_per_quote"] <= 1.30
    assert a["calls_per_quote"] > b["calls_per_quote"] + 0.1
    assert a["no_quote_in_budget_pct"] > b["no_quote_in_budget_pct"]
    assert c["p95_s"] < 3.5 < b["p95_s"]
    assert c["calls_per_quote"] > b["calls_per_quote"] + 0.1


def test_adopted_policy_never_has_more_than_one_call_in_flight(sim):
    """No SIMULADOR. O mesmo teste roda no cliente real em tests/test_quote_client.py::test_never_more_than_one_call_in_flight."""
    for scenario in ("nominal", "degradado"):
        for policy in ("A", "B"):
            assert sim[(scenario, policy)]["max_inflight"] == 1, f"{policy}/{scenario}"
        assert sim[(scenario, "C")]["max_inflight"] >= 2, "controle negativo: hedging deveria violar a propriedade"


def test_degraded_scenario_hedging_adds_load_without_helping(sim):
    b, c = sim[("degradado", "B")], sim[("degradado", "C")]
    assert c["calls_per_quote"] > b["calls_per_quote"] + 0.4
    assert abs(c["no_quote_in_budget_pct"] - b["no_quote_in_budget_pct"]) < 1.5


# --- dataset ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_dataset_profile_output_is_aggregate_only(dataset_bodies, tmp_path):
    pytest.importorskip("pandas")
    from analysis import dataset_profile

    out = tmp_path / "profile.json"
    dataset_profile.main(["--parquet", os.environ["DATASET_PATH"], "--out", str(out)])
    text = out.read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
    json.loads(text)
    leaked = [b for b in dataset_bodies if b in text]
    assert not leaked, f"{len(leaked)} texto(s) de mensagem na saida da analise"
